definitions.explanation: A person who has survived a disaster, accident, war, or other life-threatening event.

examples.japanese: {生存者|せいぞんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{捜索|そうさく}→捜索：19220_sousaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{三日後|みっかご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生存者|せいぞんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{救出|きゅうしゅつ}→救出：12918_kyuushutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A survivor was rescued three days after the earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生存者|せいぞんしゃ}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: The war survivors spoke about their experiences at the time.

notes:
A formal word for a person who has survived a life-threatening situation. Commonly used in news reporting about disasters, accidents, and wars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生存者|せいぞんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{捜索|そうさく}→捜索：19220_sousaku⟧: search for survivors
- {生存者|せいぞんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{救出|きゅうしゅつ}する→救出する：26853_kyuushutsusuru⟧: to rescue survivors
- {生存者|せいぞんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧: survivor testimony
- {生存者|せいぞんしゃ}なし: no survivors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- サバイバー: survivor — loanword, often used for reality TV or cancer survivors
- ⟦{被災者|ひさいしゃ}→被災者：25337_hisaisha⟧: disaster victim — broader, includes all affected (not just those who survived)
- ⟦{遺族|いぞく}→遺族：14886_izoku⟧: bereaved family — refers to the family members left behind

FORMS:
⟦{生存|せいぞん}→生存：04335_seizon⟧ (survival, existence) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person)
